name: Fulcrum Metals plc
summary: Based in Bromsgrove, United Kingdom, Fulcrum Metals plc, established in 2022, is primarily focused on the exploration of gold, base metals, and uranium deposits across Canada. Its principal holding is the Schreiber-Hemlo Project in Ontario, an area of around 113 square kilometers that includes the Big Bear and Jackfish Lake gold projects. The company also provides administrative services for other group entities.
